claims.quote: The indicator I(y=i) selects only the probability assigned to the true class, so the K-class sum reduces to ln(1/p_y), equivalently -log(p_y); training minimizes this quantity over labeled examples.

Assigning the true class probability close to one gives a loss near zero, whereas assigning it a very small probability produces a large penalty, so minimizing the loss pushes probability toward the observed label.
